drafted_from: tool:check-words-appear-in-a-source's own row, do-work/check_words.py and test/test_check_words.py
start_here: Say to your AI: "Before you quote anyone for me, check the exact words are on the page you cite, said by that person." It writes the request, runs tool:check-words-appear-in-a-source on your computer and keeps only the quotes it verified.
no_lists_because: It keeps no row: the quotes and their sources come in the request, and the answer is the check.
instructions: 1. For each quote, copy the words exactly as the source page shows them.
2. Give the page's address (or a file) and, when the page labels speakers in capitals (NAME:), that label.
3. Run the tool with the request's path as {request}.
4. Keep only checks with verified true; a found but unverified check means another speaker said those words on that page.
